Ava (marketing): Quick note 0 leads in the last 8h tagged "enrichment:soft_fail" after HubSpot timeouts. We risk leads being invisible to SDRs. Any objections to auto-ticketing after retry window?
Priya (ops): I want rules to avoid flooding. Current retry config: 2 retries (30s, 2m) then mark soft_fail. Proposal: only create ticket if retry_count >= 3 AND last_response_code in [429, 500, 502, 504]. Also only for leads where hs_lead_score >= 60 OR company_size >= 50.
Daniel (growth): Strong +1 for score guard. We should also include a low-latency notify to sales for hot leads instead of full ticket. Maybe Slack DM or webhook to sales-eng channel.
Chris (sales-eng): DM notify is fine. For ticketing I want a flag on the ticket: "sales_notify_sent" true/false and link to the notify. Also skip tickets for partner-sourced leads (we route those differently).
Ava (marketing): Agreed. Draft hubspot workflow logic I sketched:
```
WHEN enrichment_status == 'soft_fail'
AND enrichment_retry_count >= 3
AND last_response_code IN (429,500,502,504)
AND source != 'partner_api'
AND (hs_lead_score >= 60 OR company_size >= 50)
THEN POST to https://internal.api/tickets with payload {lead_id, email, owner_team, enrichment_logs_url, tags: ['enrich-softfail']}
```
Priya (ops): Can we include a short cooldown so repeated updates for same lead don't spawn duplicate tickets? Suggest dedupe by lead_id for 24h. Also include original_payload_snapshot in ticket.
ops-bot: alert: enrichment.soft_fail spike detected (x320% over baseline). creating incident INC-2026-342.
SRE (oncall): If you post logs, please redact PII per policy. We'll add a presigned logs link instead of raw payloads. Ping me for schema.
Daniel (growth): For the sales notify rule: if hs_lead_score >= 80 OR lead.activity_last_24h >= 5 then send Slack webhook to #sales-hot-leads with formatted summary and link to ticket if created.
Chris (sales-eng): Can we also include a small backoff before notifying sales to avoid noise during ingestion flaps? 15min buffer OK.
Ava (marketing): Yes. Summary of agreed changes:
- HubSpot workflow + webhook -> internal ticket API for soft_fail after 3 retries (Priya, ETA 48h)
- Dedupe tickets by lead_id for 24h and skip partner_api leads (Priya)
- Sales notify webhook for hot leads (score >=80 or activity spike) with 15m notify buffer (Daniel, Chris, ETA 24h)
- SRE to provide presigned log links and redaction rules for ticket payloads (SRE, ETA 24h)
- Update inbound runbook with new ticketing and notify flow (Ava, ETA 72h)
Priya (ops): I'll draft the ticket template: fields = lead_id, primary_email, company, hs_lead_score, enrichment_retry_count, last_response_code, enrichment_logs_url, original_payload_snapshot_link, assigned_queue = 'inbound-enrich'. Will add tags: ['enrich-softfail','auto-ticket']
Daniel (growth): Can we add a metric for ticket noise: % of auto-tickets that are resolved as 'no action' by ops within 48h? We'll use that to tune score thresholds.
Ava (marketing): Good call. Add to runbook metrics section.
Chris (sales-eng): One more ask: include owner_team in payload so partner owners can auto-process. If owner_team == 'partner-handovers' do not auto-ticket.
Priya (ops): Noted. I'll add that gate.
Ava (marketing): I'll open a short RFC doc and include the workflow JSON + sample ticket payload. If legal flags PII concerns we'll pivot to a sanitized alert-only mode.
Daniel (growth): Awesome. Let's ship the workflow to staging first and run a 24h smoke test. Reconcile metrics after 48h.
Ava (marketing): Thanks all. I'll coordinate the RFC and schedule a 20min sync after staging deploy. :white_check_mark:
